sentences: Instruction-cache invalidate, thread-trace data, end-of-code padding, the ISA version marker and the DS no-operation have no register, memory, SCC, VCC or EXEC effect, so they are in `NOOPS` with `s_nop` / `v_nop` / `v_pipeflush`.

`v_clrexcp` clears the TRAPSTS exception bits, which nothing translated reads (`s_getreg_b32` is unsupported and there are no traps), so it is a no-op too (since 2026-11-22; before, both it and `ds_nop` raised `Unsupported`).

`s_atc_probe` and `s_atc_probe_buffer` (SMEM) probe, that is prefetch, an address in the address translation cache: no data comes back and nothing is written, so they are no-ops too (since 2026-11-22).
The data-cache invalidations (`buffer_gl0_inv`, `buffer_gl1_inv`, `s_dcache_inv`, `s_gl1_inv`) concern coherence between waves and stay `Unsupported`.
CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_sopp_noops.py` (values, SCC and VCC survive; the data-cache invalidations are still rejected).
